messages:
zoe_marketing: hey @tim_runtime — need a concise method note + artifacts for a launch stat: "about 2x lower per-token cost using 4-bit quant + intelligent batching". Deadline: Thu AM. Can runtime run a focused smoke?

 tim_runtime: yes. propose cohorts short (<=40), medium (~120), long (~400). we'll run fp16 baseline and 4-bit quant. what hardware?

 zoe_marketing: use our staging gpus (A100s) and call out hardware in the note. want coldstart and warmed numbers, plus per-token cost calc.

 eli_eng: suggested procedure: 30 short warmups, 10 medium, 5 long, then measured runs. repeats=4. conc levels 1,6,12. export per-request csv and a short runbook.

 tim_runtime: ok. we'll produce p50/p95/p99, throughput, and a coldstart timeline PNG. quant runs will be initial (no special kernel tuning) unless we have time.

 ci-bot: job queued: https://ci.internal/run/1815554444-smoke, started at 1815554460.

 zoe_marketing: please include 8 sample traces per cohort and a 2-paragraph plain language method blurb we can paste into the blog. legal wants explicit caveats.

 tim_runtime: noted. we'll include caveats: workload dependent, batch size assumptions, cost model (GPU time + infra overhead), and model version.

 ci-bot: smoke run completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1815554444/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csvs + traces).

 tim_runtime: uploaded fp16 tuned runs. 4-bit runs are initial. link: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1815554444/fp16/ and s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1815554444/quant4_initial/

 zoe_marketing: great — marketing will draft phrasing and flag quant as "initial" if final tuning isn't done. thanks all! :sparkles:
